ios.desc:
Smart receipt scanner and expense tracker in one easy app. Scan several receipts in one go or import photos and PDFs, and Receiptly reads the store, date, total, tax and line items for you. With Receiptly Pro, you can also connect Gmail to import receipts from your emails, see where your money goes in spending reports, and export to PDF, Excel or CSV. Keep every receipt, invoice and warranty organized and ready for tax time, budgets, refunds and reimbursements.

RECEIPTLY: YOUR RECEIPT KEEPER FOR HOME AND BUSINESS
Track groceries and household spending, keep proof of purchase for returns and warranties, or log business costs, mileage and travel for your accountant. Receiptly works for families, freelancers, landlords and small businesses, and syncs with iCloud across your iPhone and iPad.

Features:
> Smart Scan: scan paper receipts with the camera or import photos and PDFs. On-device AI fills in the details where available, and you check them before saving.
> Quick capture: share a receipt from any app to Receiptly, or drag and drop images and PDFs on iPad.
> Expense tracker: log expenses, income and reimbursements to see what comes in and what goes out.
> Mileage tracker: log trips in miles or kilometers with your own rate, and Receiptly works out the amount.
> Warranty tracker: add a warranty end date to any product and get a reminder before it expires.
> Receipt organizer: categories, tags, pins and archive, plus search by store, item, amount or date.
> Duplicate check: get a warning before you save the same receipt twice.
> Siri and Shortcuts: scan receipts, find them and log expenses or mileage by voice, or add an expense automatically each time you pay with Apple Wallet.
> Widgets and Spotlight: see a category's receipts or warranty countdowns on your Home Screen, and find receipts in Spotlight search.

Receiptly Pro, an auto-renewable subscription, adds:
> Unlimited receipts, expenses and categories (the free version includes 10 of each).
> Reports: spending trends, categories, calendar, forecast, price watch, tax summary, and a business report with mileage.
> Export receipts, expenses and tax reports to PDF, Excel or CSV for your accountant.
> Travel currencies: set the currency and your own exchange rate on each receipt.
> Import receipts from Gmail. Emails are read on your device.
> Bulk import from CSV, save receipt images to Files, and get a spending summary from Siri.

For support and suggestions, email karm.singh@outlook.com
